title: Youthful Juicy Saudi Arabian Date Tagine
description: A floral and juicy post-workout dish from Saudi Arabia, made with clotted cream and tempering chocolate in a traditional tagine pot, perfect for a low-sodium diet.
instructions: Preheat the tagine pot over medium heat, adding the almond oil to the bottom.
Add the toasted pine nuts and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Add the pitted dates, rose water, orange blossom water, and honey to the tagine pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the clotted cream and tempering chocolate until the chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add the cardamom powder and salt, stirring to combine.
Continue to cook, covered, for an additional 5 minutes, or until the dates are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional toasted pine nuts if desired.
